🔥🇲🇽 <u>COAHUILA QR-GATE: MORENA DOCUMENTS 962 CASILLAS, DEMANDS NULLIFICATION</u>

Morena filed 17 electoral challenges in Coahuila demanding nullification of the June 7 local elections — irregularities in 962 voting stations, 22.6% of all ballots cast. The mechanic: QR codes inside sealed packets, voters photographed showing their PRI ballot, money traced. Morena president Ariadna Montiel: "Las personas votaron, hicieron su voto por el PRI. Una vez que votaron, se tomaron su foto con el QR." UIF, INE Fiscalización, and Fiscalía de Delitos Electorales now all in. The old PRI vote-buying playbook caught on receipts.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM TORCHES THE "MEXICO IGNORES NARCO" LIE WITH HER OWN NUMBERS</u>

President Sheinbaum slapped down right-wing narratives today: "Quien sí tenía colusión, porque es público y notorio, era el periodo de [Felipe] Calderón con [Genaro] García Luna." Under AMLO: 95,000 detained, 39 high-value. Under her: 56,000 detained + 57 relevant targets in 20 months — and intentional homicides down 46%, from 86.9 daily (Sept 2024) to 47.3 daily (May 2026). The "Mexico isn't fighting cartels" story is being run by the same PAN networks that handed the country to García Luna.

🇲🇽🏭 <u>SHEINBAUM PUTS BIENESTAR ARCHITECT IN CHARGE OF MEXICO'S DEVELOPMENT BANKS</u>

President Sheinbaum named Carlos Torres Rosas director of Nafin AND Bancomext, moving him from coordinating welfare programs (Pensión Bienestar, Adultos Mayores, Sembrando Vida) directly into Mexico's two state development banks. Torres replaces Roberto Lazzeri, who's now Mexico's ambassador to Washington for the T-MEC fight. The man who ran the social-spending machine now controls export and industrial finance — that is the 4T's theory of development in one appointment.

🇲🇽🌎 <u>EBRARD: T-MEC IS NOW A "SYSTEMIC NEGOTIATION"</u>

Foreign Minister Marcelo Ebrard told reporters the T-MEC review is no longer just about trade efficiency but "una negociación sistémica" — the world economy has stopped organizing around pure efficiency and now hinges on broader systemic alignment. Mexico formally requested a 16-year extension and is pushing to strengthen dispute-resolution mechanisms as round 2 unfolds June 16-17 in Washington. Record $50.7B in April exports and 38.8% of US FDI hitting 15 Mexican states say Mexico walks in with leverage. Trump's tariff theatrics meet Mexican calm and numbers.

🇲🇽🛢️ <u>MEXICO BOUGHT RECORD 6,258 MMPCD OF US GAS IN Q1 — 22.5% OF ALL US EXPORTS WORLDWIDE</u>

EIA data via El Financiero: Mexico averaged 6,258 million cubic feet/day of US natural gas imports in Q1 2026 — a new record for any first quarter, up 1.8% YoY, second straight year above 6 billion. Mexico is the #1 buyer of US gas on the planet, absorbing 22.5% of all US exports.

National consumption sits near 9,100 MMpcd; domestic production stalls around 2,300. That's ~75% dependency — the structural debt the 4T inherited from 36 years of neoliberal CFE and Pemex hollowing. It's also why Sheinbaum's CFE buildout — Manzanillo's 357 MW plant inaugurated Friday, four more under construction — is non-negotiable for sovereignty.

Every tariff threat from Trump's Washington runs through that pipeline. Energy independence is the only answer the empire can't veto.

🇲🇽🇵🇸 <u>SMOTRICH CANCELS THE HEBRON ACCORDS — 1997 OSLO PROTOCOL TORN UP IN ONE LINE</u>

Israeli finance minister Bezalel Smotrich — far-right faction of Netanyahu's coalition — announced today the cancellation of the Hebron Accords, the January 1997 protocol from the Oslo framework that placed ~80% of Hebron under Palestinian Authority control. "He anulado los Acuerdos de Hebrón," he said, calling it a "historic amendment" and declaring West Bank settlements "el cinturón de seguridad del Estado de Israel."

Powers over PA authorities in Hebron — including holy sites like the Tomb of the Patriarchs — revert in full to the Israeli state. The Palestinian Presidency rejected the move and called on the international community, particularly the United States, to intervene and reverse it.

The "two-state solution" Washington has been performing for 30 years is being buried in real time by the government it arms.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>CDMX HIGH-IMPACT CRIME -65% SINCE 2019, HOMICIDES -51% — BRUGADA'S NUMBERS</u>

Clara Brugada released the January-May 2026 figures versus the same period in 2019: high-impact crime down 65%, homicides down 51% (768 → 374 victims), robbery in public spaces down 72%. Daily crime average fell from 74 to under 50. All 16 alcaldías reporting declines. Versus 2025 alone: -8% high-impact, -8.8% homicides.

Enforcement side: 10,000+ detentions, 41 células criminales dismantled, 2 organization leaders and 5 operators arrested in five months. Brugada: "ayudó a prevenir que casi 100 familias diarias fueran víctimas."

Gringo media still recycles the "narco-state" line on every Mexico segment. The data has been telling another story for years. The capital of the country US travel advisories warn about just posted numbers most US cities can't dream of.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>HARFUCH: NO EVIDENCE CJNG-CHAPITOS ALLIANCE CONTINUES AFTER EL MENCHO'S DEATH</u>

Security secretary Omar García Harfuch today: no indicators the alliance between CJNG and Iván Archivaldo Guzmán's Los Chapitos held up after Nemesio "El Mencho" Oseguera was killed, though it can't be fully ruled out. Mencho was, in Harfuch's words, "el eslabón más fuerte" between the two organizations.

The cooperation was thinner than the gringo press painted: "En algún momento hubo algún tipo de financiamiento o de refuerzos de personal por el sur de Sinaloa, nada más." CJNG stayed stable through regional leaderships — Mencho's stepson Juan Carlos Valencia González among the strongest — without the fragmentation US analysts predicted to justify "joint operations."

Mexican intelligence reading the cartel map without ICE, DEA, or Pentagon "help." Sovereignty is a method, not a slogan.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>HACIENDA + FSTSE SIGN 9% RAISE FOR 800K FEDERAL WORKERS — RETROACTIVE TO JANUARY 1</u>

Just signed: 9% increase to salary and prestaciones for ~800,000 administrative and operative federal workers, retroactive to January 1, 2026. Aguinaldo and vales de despensa adjusted upward. Lowest-paid get the biggest bump — no worker stays below the minimum wage. FSTSE leader Marco Antonio García Ayala called it "una recomposición de la percepción salarial."

Healthcare branch — 600K+ at Salud, ISSSTE, DIF — up next. Inflation sits at 3.94%. Real wages have outpaced prices every single year of the 4T. Neoliberalism spent 36 years cutting bureaucrat pay in the name of austerity. This sexenio is undoing it line by line.

🚨🇲🇽 <u>SHEINBAUM DECREES HOME OFFICE + SCHOOL SUSPENSION ACROSS CDMX & GUADALAJARA FOR MUNDIAL</u>

Decree just published in the Diario Oficial: federal offices in CDMX cut in-person work at 3 PM on June 17, go 100% remote on June 24. Guadalajara goes fully remote on June 18 for México vs. South Korea. Schools at every level — preescolar through universidades, public and private under SEP — suspended. Health, civil protection, emergency services stay open.

State coordinating a country of 130 million around a sporting calendar with surgical precision — administrative capacity neoliberalism spent 36 years trying to dismantle. Same week Washington can't keep its own World Cup volunteers' visa paperwork straight.
